matchingPolicy.goal: Find the closest reproducible GP-50 configuration from measured reference characteristics.
matchingPolicy.method: Measured reference fingerprint followed by empirical comparison against a real GP-50 capture; single-file analysis alone cannot recover hidden original studio settings.

v7Calibration.method: Reference recording vs actual GP-50 capture using matching DSP fingerprint features
v7Calibration.note: Calibration similarity is empirical feedback; it is not a claim of recovering unknown original studio settings.

midi.reason: Exact parameter/SysEx mapping should be taken from Valeton's GP-50 MIDI List before enabling automated preset writes.

snapToneResearch.official: Valeton describes SnapTone/NAM support with up to 80 stored files and 50 curated files.
snapToneResearch.practicalConstraint: Independent GP-50 documentation and owner reports indicate SnapTone operation has routing limitations around AMP/CAB/IR. ValeAnalize therefore treats SnapTone as a distinct route and validates it empirically instead of assuming AMP+IR layering is always available.
snapToneResearch.namCompatibility: Community reverse-engineering reports that the GP-50 workflow accepts NAM A1 rather than NAM A2; this is treated as a compatibility warning, not as an invented Valeton specification.
